title: MacArthur's 1955 West Point interplanetary war speech
summary: Jesse Michels tells of MacArthur's 1955 West Point interplanetary war speech, about 1955 at West Point, New York, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: During a 1955 speech at West Point, General MacArthur told assembled cadetses, "The next war will be an interplanetary war.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1955 the American general Douglas MacArthur gave a speech at West Point, the US Army's officer academy in New York. According to Michels, MacArthur told the cadets that "the next war will be an interplanetary war." Michels raises it because, if MacArthur meant it, a top military leader was openly picturing conflict beyond Earth decades ago.
